title: Process observed in recent work

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Gather evidence from stakeholders, SMEs, research, QA, and implementation constraints.

steps.title: Clarify
steps.description: Scope the problem, audience, terminology, taxonomy, workflows, and dependencies.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: Make scope, priorities, risks, and open questions explicit.

steps.title: Structure
steps.description: Organize phases, epics, stories, ownership, standards, and delivery criteria.

steps.title: Explore and validate
steps.description: Create flows and prototypes, review alternatives, and incorporate feedback.

steps.title: Document and deliver
steps.description: Maintain documentation, components, specifications, and Jira-linked handoff.

steps.title: Close the loop
steps.description: Review implementation, testing, and QA, and feed findings back into the design system.

principles: Make decisions, risks, and dependencies visible.
Balance system consistency with product-specific needs.
Work with PMs, engineering, QA, SMEs, technical writers, and design-system contributors.
Use AI to support documentation and specification without hiding human review, feasibility, and safety.
Never promise a universal time-to-value without knowing scope, access, and team autonomy.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §4 — Process & Collaboration (editorial synthesis of monthly records; not yet confirmed as Rodrigo's standard process across all contexts)
